create_padding_sequence: create padding sequence for a convolution given kernel size, dilation rate, spatial dimensions, and channel index
test_valid_padding: test the valid padding function that returns no padding for a given effective kernel size
test_same_padding: test the same padding function that pads so output size matches input size for stride=1
test_causal_padding: test the causal padding function that pre-pads so output has no dependence on the future
test_full_padding: test the full padding function that returns maximal padding without convolving over padded elements
